subject.title: Rust Mapper emits zero contextFiles for seeds

question: Should Rust seed context include only direct crate structure, or should the mapper recursively traverse declared modules subject to an explicit context budget?
rationale: The requested module-tree behavior affects prompt size, traversal semantics, and support expectations across diverse Rust layouts; those limits are product and maintenance policy rather than a mechanical bug fix alone.

options.title: Bound direct crate context
options.body: Include Cargo.toml, the paired main/lib entrypoint, and directly declared module files with a fixed deduplication and file-count limit.

options.title: Traverse module trees recursively
options.body: Follow nested module declarations after defining path-attribute, cycle, generated-file, and context-budget behavior.

options.title: Limit scope to manifest and entrypoints
options.body: Address the highest-value dependency context first and track module resolution separately if needed.

recommendation.title: Bound direct crate context
recommendation.body: Include Cargo.toml, the paired main/lib entrypoint, and directly declared module files with a fixed deduplication and file-count limit.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main history pass is needed to identify the Rust-mapper area owner before assigning the design choice.
